suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
})
df <- readxl::read_excel("inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx", sheet = "5 groups")
cat("Dimensions:", dim(df), "\n")
cat("Column names:", names(df), "\n\n")
cat("Non-NA counts per column:\n")
print(colSums(!is.na(df)))
cat("\nFirst 5 rows:\n")
print(head(df, 5))
# Build list of 5 sets, dropping NAs
sets <- lapply(df, function(x) na.omit(as.character(x)))
cat("\nSet sizes:\n")
print(sapply(sets, length))
# Universe unique count
all_elements <- unique(unlist(sets))
cat("\nTotal unique elements across all sets:", length(all_elements), "\n")
saveRDS(sets, "sets.rds")
saveRDS(all_elements, "all_elements.rds")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(VennDiagram)
  library(dplyr)
})
sets <- readRDS("data/sets.rds")
A <- sets$A; B <- sets$B; C <- sets$C; D <- sets$D; E <- sets$E
cat("Set sizes: A=", length(A), " B=", length(B), " C=", length(C),
    " D=", length(D), " E=", length(E), "\n", sep="")
# Pairwise intersections
ij <- function(x,y) length(intersect(x,y))
cat("\nPairwise intersections (|X ∩ Y|):\n")
cat("A∩B =", ij(A,B), "\n")
cat("A∩C =", ij(A,C), "\n")
cat("A∩D =", ij(A,D), "\n")
cat("A∩E =", ij(A,E), "\n")
cat("B∩C =", ij(B,C), "\n")
cat("B∩D =", ij(B,D), "\n")
cat("B∩E =", ij(B,E), "\n")
cat("C∩D =", ij(C,D), "\n")
cat("C∩E =", ij(C,E), "\n")
cat("D∩E =", ij(D,E), "\n")
# 5-way intersection
all5 <- Reduce(intersect, list(A,B,C,D,E))
cat("\n|A ∩ B ∩ C ∩ D ∩ E| =", length(all5), "\n")
# Union + Jaccard
universe <- unique(c(A,B,C,D,E))
cat("\nUnion |A ∪ B ∪ C ∪ D ∪ E| =", length(universe), "\n")
# Region counts via VennDiagram's get.venn.partitions (for verification)
vp <- VennDiagram::get.venn.partitions(list(A=A,B=B,C=C,D=D,E=E))
cat("\nTop 15 disjoint region counts (VennDiagram):\n")
print(head(vp[order(-vp$count), c(1:5,7)], 15))
saveRDS(vp, "data/venn_partitions.rds")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(VennDiagram)
})
sets <- readRDS("sets.rds")
A <- sets$A; B <- sets$B; C <- sets$C; D <- sets$D; E <- sets$E
# VennDiagram::venn.diagram writes a PNG; this is the standard proportional Venn
# for 5 sets (ellipses sized roughly proportional to set sizes, with counts).
out_png <- "proportional_venn.png"
unlink(out_png)
vd <- venn.diagram(
  x = list(A=A, B=B, C=C, D=D, E=E),
  category.names = c("A","B","C","D","E"),
  filename = out_png,
  output = TRUE,
  imagetype = "png",
  resolution = 300,
  compression = "lzw",
  lwd = 1.5,
  col = c("#1f77b4","#ff7f0e","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd"),
  fill = c("#1f77b455","#ff7f0e55","#2ca02c55","#d6272855","#9467bd55"),
  cex = 0.9,
  fontface = "bold",
  fontfamily = "sans",
  cat.cex = 1.2,
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  cat.pos = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  cat.dist = c(0.30, 0.30, 0.30, 0.30, 0.30),
  cat.col = c("#1f77b4","#ff7f0e","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd"),
  rotation.degree = 0,
  main = "Proportional Venn Diagram of 5 Sets",
  main.cex = 1.4,
  main.fontface = "bold",
  main.fontfamily = "sans"
)
cat("File created:", out_png, "\n")
cat("Exists:", file.exists(out_png), "\n")
cat("Size:", file.info(out_png)$size, "bytes\n")
# Render a small summary table of disjoint regions for the report
vp <- VennDiagram::get.venn.partitions(list(A=A,B=B,C=C,D=D,E=E))
vp_sorted <- vp[order(-vp$..count..), c("..set..","..count..")]
cat("\nAll non-empty disjoint regions:\n")
print(vp_sorted[vp_sorted$..count.. > 0, ], row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(vp_sorted, "venn_partitions.rds")
